Sounds simple, but as you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various obstacles, such as moving platforms, spinning blades, and treacherous terrain.

Fireboy and Watergirl have unique abilities that complement each other perfectly. Fireboy can walk on lava and burn certain blocks, while Watergirl can swim in water and extinguish flames. By working together, the duo can overcome even the most daunting challenges.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter new enemies, obstacles, and power-ups that require strategic thinking and coordination to overcome.
